settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: The size the game draws at. Your screen's own size gives the sharpest picture.

settings.label: Window mode
settings.help: A borderless window looks like fullscreen but switches to other programs instantly.

settings.label: Vertical sync
settings.help: Matches frames to your monitor and stops tearing. Skyrim's physics expect 60 frames per second: without VSync or a frame rate limit, objects can fly around.

settings.label: Lock the frame rate at 60
settings.help: Caps the game at 60 frames per second, the rate its physics are made for. Turn it off only with a physics rate that matches your frame rate.

settings.label: Physics rate
settings.help: How many physics steps the game takes per second. Above 60 frames per second, set it to your frame rate, or objects can jitter and fly around.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.help: How wide the camera sees, in degrees. The game uses 80.

settings.label: Default field of view
settings.help: The field of view the game falls back to; keep it the same as Field of view.

settings.label: First-person hands field of view
settings.help: How wide your hands and weapon are drawn in first person, separately from the world.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: 1 is the game's default; higher is brighter.

settings.label: Brightness adjustment
settings.help: Added to the game's own lighting; 0 changes nothing.

settings.label: Contrast adjustment
settings.help: Added to the game's own contrast; 0 changes nothing.

settings.label: Colour saturation adjustment
settings.help: Below 0 washes colours out, above 0 strengthens them; 0 changes nothing.

settings.label: Bloom threshold adjustment
settings.help: Moves the point where bright areas start to glow; 0 changes nothing.

settings.label: Precise HDR colours (64-bit)
settings.help: Renders light with more colour precision, which removes banding in skies and fog, at some cost in frame rate.

settings.label: Keep running in the background
settings.help: The game keeps running while another window is in front, instead of pausing.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges. TAA looks best but blurs a little; FXAA is cheaper.

settings.label: God rays
settings.help: Beams of light through trees, windows and fog.

settings.label: God rays indoors
settings.help: Also draws god rays inside buildings and dungeons.

settings.label: Depth of field
settings.help: Blurs distant scenery, and the background during conversations.

settings.label: Depth of field strength
settings.help: How strongly the background blurs when depth of field is on.

settings.label: Anamorphic lens flare
settings.help: Adds horizontal streaks to bright lights.

settings.label: Screen space reflections
settings.help: Reflections on wet and shiny surfaces.

settings.label: Reflection resolution divider
settings.help: 1 draws screen space reflections at full resolution, 2 at half, and so on: faster, but blurrier.

settings.label: Rain occlusion
settings.help: Keeps rain and snow from falling under roofs.

settings.label: Particles
settings.help: The most particles (smoke, sparks, magic) drawn at once. More looks fuller and costs frame rate; the game uses 750.

settings.label: Sun size
settings.help: The size of the sun's disc; the game uses 425.

settings.label: Sun glare size
settings.help: The size of the glare around the sun; the game uses 600.

settings.label: Sun brightness
settings.help: How bright the sun's disc is drawn.

settings.label: Sun glare strength
settings.help: How strong the glare around the sun is.

settings.label: Shadow quality
settings.help: Sharpness of shadows. High costs video memory and frame rate.

settings.label: Shadow distance
settings.help: How far away outdoor shadows are drawn. The game's presets use 3000 (Low) to 10000 (Ultra).

settings.label: Interior shadow distance
settings.help: How far away shadows are drawn indoors.

settings.label: Sharp shadow range
settings.help: The range around you that gets the sharpest shadows; further away, shadows come from coarser maps.

settings.label: Shadow softness
settings.help: How much shadow edges are blurred; 0 gives hard edges.

settings.label: Shadow bias
settings.help: Lower values keep shadows attached to what casts them but can draw stripes on surfaces; higher values avoid stripes but shadows can float.

settings.label: Detailed shadows near the view centre
settings.help: How many objects you look at get extra detailed shadows. Each costs frame rate.

settings.label: Shadows on trees
settings.help: Trees receive shadows from the sun and from other objects.

settings.label: Shadows of distant land
settings.help: Distant hills and mountains cast shadows.

settings.label: Shadows of tall trees
settings.help: Tall trees cast shadows over a longer distance.

settings.label: Tall tree shadow height
settings.help: Trees up to this height cast the long-distance shadows above.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.help: Soft shadows in corners and where objects meet.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion strength
settings.help: How dark ambient occlusion makes corners and contact points.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion radius
settings.help: How far around each point ambient occlusion looks for nearby surfaces.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion bias
settings.help: Ignores small differences in depth; higher values remove speckles on flat surfaces.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion falloff
settings.help: How quickly the darkening fades out.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion depth difference
settings.help: How large a difference in depth still darkens a surface.

settings.label: Grass
settings.help: Draws grass at all.

settings.label: Place grass while you play
settings.help: Places grass on the ground as you move around. Off, the only grass is what a grass cache holds.

settings.label: Use a grass cache
settings.help: Loads grass from pre-generated cache files instead. Only useful after making a grass cache with a tool for that.

settings.label: Grass fades in
settings.help: Grass appears gradually at the edge of its distance instead of popping in.

settings.label: Grass spacing (density)
settings.help: The room each tuft of grass needs. Lower values make grass denser and cost frame rate; the game uses 20.

settings.label: Grass variety
settings.help: How many kinds of grass can grow on one ground texture.

settings.label: Grass distance
settings.help: How far away grass is drawn.

settings.label: Grass fade range
settings.help: Over how much distance grass fades out beyond the grass distance.

settings.label: Grass sway, light wind
settings.help: How much grass moves in light wind.

settings.label: Grass sway, strong wind
settings.help: How much grass moves in strong wind.

settings.label: Dynamic tree models
settings.help: Draws trees as dynamic models that can move; off, trees are static models.

settings.label: Tree animations
settings.help: Trees sway in the wind. Off saves a little time in forests.

settings.label: Detailed tree models
settings.help: Uses the most detailed tree models up close.

settings.label: Detailed trees at once
settings.help: The most trees drawn with detailed models at the same time.

settings.label: Detailed tree distance
settings.help: Up to here trees use their detailed models; beyond, simpler ones.

settings.label: Tree detail level 1 distance
settings.help: Where trees switch to their first lower level of detail.

settings.label: Tree detail level 2 distance
settings.help: Where trees switch to their second lower level of detail.

settings.label: Improved snow
settings.help: The glittering snow shader of the Special Edition.

settings.label: Snow on top of objects
settings.help: Lays snow (and similar) over the tops of rocks and buildings. Mods without the texture it needs show it wrongly.

settings.label: Snow on nearby ground
settings.help: Blends snow into some landscape textures around snowy areas.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion on snow
settings.help: Darkens corners and contact points on snow too.

settings.label: Snow sparkles
settings.help: Snow glitters in the light.

settings.label: Sparkle brightness
settings.help: How bright the glitter on snow is.

settings.label: Sparkle density
settings.help: Lower values make the glitter denser; the game uses 0.85.

settings.label: Sparkle size
settings.help: Lower values make the glitter bigger; the game uses 6.

settings.label: Snow rim lighting
settings.help: A soft glow along the edges of snowy surfaces.

settings.label: Rim lighting strength
settings.help: How bright that glow is.

settings.label: Rim lighting on objects
settings.help: Shapes the glow on snowy objects; higher values make it narrower.

settings.label: Rim lighting on land
settings.help: Shapes the glow on snowy ground; higher values make it narrower.

settings.label: Water reflection blur
settings.help: How blurred screen space reflections on water are.

settings.label: Water reflection strength
settings.help: How strong screen space reflections on water are.

settings.label: Water reflection ripple
settings.help: How much waves distort screen space reflections on water.

settings.label: Blood and scorch marks
settings.help: Marks that blood, spells and arrows leave on the world and on characters.

settings.label: Gore
settings.help: Dismemberment and other gory effects.

settings.label: New marks per frame
settings.help: How many new blood or scorch marks can appear in the world in one frame.

settings.label: New marks on characters per frame
settings.help: How many new marks can appear on characters in one frame.

settings.label: Marks per character
settings.help: The most marks one character can carry.

settings.label: Mark lifetime
settings.help: How long marks stay.

settings.label: Mark distance
settings.help: How far away marks are drawn.

settings.label: Object fade
settings.help: How far away objects stay visible. The game's presets use 5 (Low) to 30 (Ultra).

settings.label: Actor fade
settings.help: How far away people and creatures stay visible.

settings.label: Item fade
settings.help: How far away small items stay visible.

settings.label: Object detail level 1 distance
settings.help: Where objects switch to their first lower level of detail. The game's 9999999 keeps them at full detail.

settings.label: Object detail level 2 distance
settings.help: Where objects switch to their second lower level of detail.

settings.label: Light fade start
settings.help: Where light from fires and lamps starts to fade out.

settings.label: Light fade range
settings.help: Over how much distance that light fades out.

settings.label: Flickering light distance
settings.help: Up to here torches and candles flicker; beyond, they shine steadily.

settings.label: Shiny reflections fade start
settings.help: Where reflections on shiny objects start to fade. Higher values keep them visible further away.

settings.label: Shiny reflections fade end
settings.help: Where those reflections are gone.

settings.label: Glossy highlights fade start
settings.help: Where glossy highlights on objects start to fade. Higher values keep them visible further away.

settings.label: Glossy highlights fade end
settings.help: Where those highlights are gone.

settings.label: Refraction fade start
settings.help: Where see-through distortion effects start to fade. Higher values keep them visible further away.

settings.label: Refraction fade end
settings.help: Where those effects are gone.

settings.label: Surface detail fade start
settings.help: Where decals on objects start to fade. Higher values keep them visible further away.

settings.label: Surface detail fade end
settings.help: Where those decals are gone.

settings.label: Tree distance
settings.help: How far away trees are drawn.

settings.label: Detailed terrain distance
settings.help: Where the most detailed distant terrain ends.

settings.label: Medium terrain distance
settings.help: Where medium detail distant terrain ends.

settings.label: Terrain distance
settings.help: How far away distant terrain is drawn at all.

settings.label: Terrain detail multiplier
settings.help: Multiplies the terrain distances above for the land's levels of detail.

settings.label: Distant land fades in
settings.help: Distant terrain fades in gradually; off avoids flickering at its edge.

settings.label: Always-visible objects distance
settings.help: How far away landmarks that never fade stay drawn.

settings.label: Large objects area
settings.help: The area around you (5 means 5 by 5 cells) where buildings, rocks and other large objects show in full detail. Use odd numbers; the game's presets use 5 (Low) to 11 (Ultra).

settings.label: Loaded cells (uGridsToLoad)
settings.help: How many cells around you are fully loaded with everything in them. Above 5 can make the game unstable; leave it at 5 unless your mod setup asks for more.

settings.label: Quest markers
settings.help: Quest markers on the compass and the map.

settings.label: Floating quest markers
settings.help: Markers floating over quest targets in the world.

settings.label: HUD opacity
settings.help: 1 is fully visible, 0 hides the HUD.

settings.label: Dialogue subtitles
settings.help: Subtitles when you talk to someone.

settings.label: General subtitles
settings.help: Subtitles for what people around you say.

settings.label: Combat chatter
settings.help: Enemies and followers talk during fights.

settings.label: Kill moves
settings.help: Finishing moves and their kill camera.

settings.label: World edge borders
settings.help: Invisible walls at the edges of the map. Off lets you walk further, into unfinished land.

settings.label: Characters use up arrows
settings.help: Archers spend the arrows they carry instead of having endless ones.

settings.label: Lively ragdolls
settings.help: Bodies react more when bumped.

settings.label: Hit reactions
settings.help: Characters react physically when struck.

settings.label: Hit reaction strength
settings.help: How strongly they react.

settings.label: Arrow tilt, first person
settings.help: How far arrows fly above the crosshair at first; lower shoots straighter. The game uses 2.

settings.label: Arrow tilt, third person
settings.help: The same in third person. The game uses 2.5.

settings.label: Bolt tilt, first person
settings.help: The same for crossbow bolts. The game uses 1.

settings.label: Arrow hit distance
settings.help: The farthest distance at which arrows can hit characters.

settings.label: Weapon change time
settings.help: How long a weapon change takes to finish.

settings.label: Over-encumbered reminder
settings.help: How often the game reminds you that you carry too much.

settings.label: Ground grip
settings.help: Higher values make the ground grippier.

settings.label: Book opening delay
settings.help: How long opening a book takes.

settings.label: Camera delay after dismounting
settings.help: How long the camera takes to settle after you get off a horse.

settings.label: Autosaves
settings.help: Lets the game save automatically.

settings.label: Autosave slots
settings.help: How many autosaves are kept before the oldest is replaced.

settings.label: Save when pausing
settings.help: Saves when you open the pause menu, at most once per interval below.

settings.label: Warn about missing mods when loading
Forced saves by quests and mods
Save file compression
settings.help: LZ4 is the game's default and the quickest; none makes larger files.

settings.label: Text language
settings.help: The language of the game's text. Its language files have to be installed.

settings.label: Intro video
settings.help: The Bethesda logo video at start-up.

settings.label: Mods entry in the menu
settings.help: The Mods entry of the game's own menu, for Bethesda.net mods.

settings.label: Bethesda.net and Creation Club
settings.help: Connects to Bethesda.net for news and Creations. Off stops the news; the menu entries stay.

settings.label: Creation Club offer already seen
settings.help: On, the game no longer offers its free Creation Club content at start-up.

settings.label: Item name length
settings.help: The most letters allowed when naming enchanted items.

settings.label: Free world map camera
settings.help: The world map camera can turn and tilt much further.

settings.label: Sharp world map
settings.help: Removes the blur over distant parts of the world map.

settings.label: Console height
settings.help: How much of the screen the console covers.

settings.label: Console history
settings.help: How many characters of past console output are kept.

settings.label: Screenshot files
settings.help: Where Print Screen saves screenshots and how their names start, for example C:\Screenshots\Skyrim. The game adds a number.

settings.label: Controller
settings.help: Turn off when a controller is plugged in but you play with mouse and keyboard.

settings.label: Mouse sideways scale
settings.help: How far the camera turns for sideways mouse movement, with the mouse sensitivity on top.

settings.label: Mouse up and down scale
settings.help: How far the camera tilts for up and down mouse movement.

settings.label: Mouse wheel zoom speed
settings.help: How fast the mouse wheel moves the third-person camera.

settings.label: Exterior cell buffer
settings.help: How many outdoor cells stay in memory after you leave them. More uses more RAM and loads less when you come back. The default is 36.

settings.label: Interior cell buffer
settings.help: How many interiors stay in memory after you leave them. The default is 3.

settings.label: Script memory
settings.help: Memory the script engine (Papyrus) may use. Load orders with many scripted mods often raise it; guides commonly use 2457600. The default is 76800.

settings.label: Cached sound size
settings.help: Sounds up to this size, in bytes, stay in memory once played.

settings.label: ENB: video memory
settings.help: Video memory ENB may use when it does not detect it. Guides use the size ENB's VRAM Size Test tool reports.

settings.label: ENB: detect video memory
settings.help: ENB measures the video memory itself and ignores the size above.

settings.label: ENB: reserved memory
settings.help: Memory ENB sets aside for loading game data. Guides usually use 256 to 1024.

settings.label: ENB: compress memory
settings.help: Compresses data in memory: uses less RAM and a little more processor time.

settings.label: Script logging
settings.help: Writes script logs into Logs\Script in this instance's My Games folder. Useful when a mod misbehaves; slows the game a little.

settings.label: Script trace messages
settings.help: Adds the messages mods write for debugging to the script log. Needs script logging.

settings.label: Script debug information
settings.help: Adds line numbers to script errors in the log.

settings.label: Script profiling
settings.help: Records how long scripts take, for mod authors. Slows the game.

settings.label: Script time after loading
settings.help: How long scripts may run after a save loads, before you get control.

settings.label: Editor markers
settings.help: Shows the markers mod authors place in the world. Not for normal play.

settings.help: Multiplies the terrain distances above for the land's levels of detail.

settings.label: Loaded cells (uGridsToLoad)
settings.help: How many cells around you are fully loaded with everything in them. Above 5 can make the game unstable; leave it at 5 unless your mod setup asks for more.

settings.label: Difficulty
settings.help: Survival changes much more than damage: it limits saving and adds needs like food and sleep.

settings.label: Floating quest markers
settings.help: Markers over targets in the world, not only on the compass.

settings.label: Dialogue subtitles
settings.help: Subtitles when you talk to someone.

settings.label: General subtitles
settings.help: Subtitles for what people around you say.

settings.label: Dialogue camera
settings.help: The camera moves to whoever is speaking.

settings.label: Combat chatter
settings.help: Enemies and companions talk during fights.

settings.label: Characters use up ammunition
settings.help: Characters spend the ammunition they carry instead of having endless rounds.

settings.label: Fit the quick loot box to its contents
Over-encumbered reminder
settings.help: How often the game reminds you that you carry too much.

settings.label: World edge borders
settings.help: Invisible walls at the edges of the map. Off lets you walk further, into unfinished land.

settings.label: Sprint while the world loads
settings.help: Lets you keep sprinting while nearby areas are still loading.

settings.label: Autosaves
settings.help: Lets the game save automatically.

settings.label: Autosave slots
settings.help: How many autosaves are kept before the oldest is replaced.

settings.label: Save when opening the Pip-Boy
settings.help: At most once per interval below.

settings.label: Save when quitting to the main menu
Warn about missing mods when loading
Look for missing Creations when loading
settings.help: Offers to find Creations a save needs but that are not installed.

settings.label: Forced saves by quests and mods
Fade in after loading
settings.help: The screen fades in when a save has loaded; off shows it at once.

settings.label: Text language
settings.help: The language of the game's text. Its language files have to be installed.

settings.label: Intro video
settings.help: The Bethesda logo video at start-up.

settings.label: S.P.E.C.I.A.L. intro and menu wait
settings.help: Sometimes plays the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. video at start-up and waits 5 seconds before the main menu can be skipped; off removes both.

settings.label: Main menu music file
settings.help: The music file the main menu plays, relative to the game folder.

settings.label: Bethesda.net and Creations
settings.help: Connects to Bethesda.net for news and Creations. Off stops the news; the menu entries stay.

settings.label: HUD colour
settings.help: The colour of the HUD and the Pip-Boy interface.

settings.label: HUD warning colour
settings.help: The colour of damage and warnings on the HUD.

settings.label: Workbench highlight colour
settings.help: The colour of the item you are changing at a workbench.

settings.label: Wire highlight colour
settings.help: The colour of wires while connecting them in workshop mode.

settings.label: Pip-Boy screen effects
settings.help: Scan lines and flicker on the Pip-Boy screen.

settings.label: Pip-Boy light in the Pip-Boy colour
settings.help: Off gives the Pip-Boy light a neutral colour.

settings.label: Pip-Boy screen resolution
settings.help: Double draws the Pip-Boy screen sharper.

settings.label: Pip-Boy companion app
settings.help: Lets the Pip-Boy app on a phone connect to the game.

settings.label: Console hotkeys
settings.help: Lets the console INI below bind console commands to keys.

settings.label: Console command at start-up
settings.help: Runs this console command when the game starts.

settings.label: Console height
settings.help: How much of the screen the console covers.

settings.label: Console history
settings.help: How many characters of past console output are kept.

settings.label: Console selection colour
settings.help: The colour of the object you select with the console. Its default, 0, is the game's own colour.

settings.label: Screenshot files
settings.help: Where Print Screen saves screenshots and how their names start, for example C:\Screenshots\Fallout4. The game adds a number.

settings.label: Pip-Boy cursor speed with a controller
Mouse sideways scale
settings.help: How far the camera turns for sideways mouse movement, with the mouse sensitivity on top.

settings.label: Mouse up and down scale
settings.help: How far the camera tilts for up and down mouse movement.

settings.label: Mouse wheel zoom speed
settings.help: How fast the mouse wheel moves the third-person camera.

settings.label: Windows mouse handling
settings.help: Moves the mouse at Windows' own speed. Useful in some setups, but unreliable in play.

settings.label: Loose mod files
settings.help: Fallout 4 ignores mod files that are not packed in archives unless this is on.

settings.label: Plugin choice in the game's launcher
settings.help: Lets the game's own launcher turn plugins on and off. BetterNMM manages plugins itself.

settings.label: Precombined meshes
settings.help: Draws many objects as one merged mesh: a large performance gain. Keep it on unless a mod says otherwise.

settings.label: Pre-calculated visibility
settings.help: Skips objects hidden behind others. Keep it on unless a mod says otherwise.

settings.label: Script memory
settings.help: Memory for running scripts, in bytes. Mods with many scripts may need more.

settings.label: Load script data in the background
ENB: video memory
settings.help: Video memory ENB may use when it does not detect it. Guides use the size ENB's VRAM Size Test tool reports.

settings.label: ENB: detect video memory
settings.help: ENB measures the video memory itself and ignores the size above.

settings.label: Script logging
settings.help: Writes script logs into Logs\Script in this instance's My Games folder. Useful when a mod misbehaves; slows the game a little.

settings.label: Script trace messages
settings.help: Adds the messages mods write for debugging to the script log. Needs script logging.

settings.label: Script debug information
settings.help: Adds line numbers to script errors in the log.

settings.label: Script profiling
settings.help: Records how long scripts take, for mod authors. Slows the game.

settings.label: Script time after loading
settings.help: How long scripts may run after a save loads, before you get control.
